contents.name: Lemma 29, even rectangle approximation
contents.detail: The formula printed in this source fails its asserted range at the positive shift used in Theorem 41; it is not used. A corrected local window is proved separately.
contents.reason: The printed expression gives P′(0)≥1+e′²/4>1 for t=3/4 and delta′=delta/4, contradicting the claimed |P′|≤1; the local item proves a different corrected formula.

contents.name: Lemma 40, odd reciprocal polynomial approximation
contents.detail: The theorem carrier retains the source approximation claim and marks the local construction proof as unresolved.

contents.name: Theorem 41, bounded gapped Moore–Penrose transform
contents.detail: The full degree, error, boundedness, and target normalization claim is preserved with an explicit proof-status escalation.

contents.name: Definition 43, block-encoding construction and access
contents.detail: The QLSP item states the finite block normalization and supplied access rather than treating matrix data as an oracle.
